# Xenon Design System (Zx)

> Xenon is a dependency-free design system for browser applications; Zx is its product-agnostic
> vanilla-JavaScript implementation. ES2022 modules, WAI-ARIA-accessible native
> controls, semantic `--zx-*` design tokens with light/dark/density theming, and lifecycle-safe
> components. Source modules run directly in the browser; a build step emits ESM, IIFE-global,
> ZeyOS binding, and CSS bundles. Zero runtime dependencies.

Instantiate every component as `new Component(target, options)` where `target` is an Element, a
selector string, or `null` (the component creates and owns its root, retrieved via `.toElement()`).
Subscribe with `.on(type, fn)` or an `on<type>` option; handlers receive a `CustomEvent` whose
`.detail` is an object. Call `.destroy()` to clean up. The same API is available as ESM named
exports and as `window.zx.*`.

## Documentation
- [Documentation site](https://zx.zeyos.com/docs.html): getting started, every component with a live demo and its JavaScript source, and the application layouts. Machine index: [llms.txt](https://zx.zeyos.com/llms.txt).
- [README](../README.md): what Zx is, quick start (ESM + global script), component index, theming, and browser support.
- [API reference](llms.md): per-component constructor options, methods, and events for all public components plus the core helpers.
- [Skill](https://zx.zeyos.com/skills/zx/SKILL.md): task-oriented guide — mental model, recipes, ZeyOS HTTP client, theming, gotchas, commands.
- [Changelog](../CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release, including behaviour changes an upgrade has to account for.
- [Contributor contract](https://github.com/zeyos/zx/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for editing component source (token rules, render-time state, listeners, ARIA/APG).

## Components
- Inputs: `button()`, `buttonGroup()`, `badge()`/`badgeGroup()`, `CheckButton`,
  `Toggle`, `Search`,
  `Select` (APG combobox; `filter: false|'local'|async`; priority, status, permission, and
  `Select.entity()` presets), `Checklist`, `TagPicker` (icon/color identity), `NumberField`, `Rating`, `Slider`,
  `copyButton()`/`CopyInput`, `DatePicker`, `MonthPicker`, `TimePicker`,
  `Datebox`/`DateTimeBox`, `DateRangePicker`/`DateRangeBox`, `Timebox`.
- Overlays: `Message` (toasts/inline/progress), `Modal`, `Dialog` (+ `alert`/`confirm`/`prompt` Promises), `Sheet` (edge-anchored Dialog; `side`, `modal: true|'trap-focus'|false`, `backdrop`, `snap` detents, swipe-to-dismiss), `SheetStack` (drill-down; `stack`/`cascade`), `Dropdown`, `MenuButton`, `ContextMenu` (right-click; `selector` for per-row menus), `Tooltip`/`tooltip()`/`describe()`.
- Data: `Table` (sortable, selectable, sticky header, opt-in inline cell/row editing, row reorder,
  column visibility), shared `RecordView` state through `TableView`, `CardView`, and `KanbanView`,
  `Grid` with single-click editing and `Grid.BillingItems()`, engine-neutral
  `Chart` with injected `ChartJsAdapter`, `Calendar` (agenda/day/week/month/year, pointer/keyboard
  drag and resize, `optimistic: true|false`), backend-neutral nested `Filter`, simple client-side
  `DataFilter`, `Pagination` (+ pure `paginationRange()`), `TreeView` (APG tree),
  `Finder` (Miller columns).
- Forms: `Form`, `Fieldset`, `Questionnaire` (guided one-question-at-a-time flow with branching), `Field` (type registry), `ValueList`, `MultiValueEditor`, `FieldUpload`.
- Layout: `stack()`/`grid()`/`aspect()` (spacing, an intrinsically reflowing grid, a fixed-ratio
  box), `Groupbox`, `Card` (media/title link/actions/footer), `AppIcon` (generic tile geometry;
  circular `zeyosAppIcon()` application presets and compact `moduleChip()` identities),
  `Aurora` (one- to four-colour ambient
  canvas light; shared material roles govern chrome and overlays), `Avatar`, `Panel` (header/footer action
  buttons), `MasterPanel`, `Tabbox`
  (`variant: 'divided'|'bracket'|'line'|'segmented'`), `NavigationBar`, `AppSidebar` (expanded and
  minimized vertical states plus horizontal rail layouts), `AccountMenu`, `Launcher`,
  `spinner()`/`ProgressBar`/`InlineLoading`, `skeleton()`/`skeletonText()`/`skeletonTable()`,
  `Toolbar` (APG toolbar with overflow menu), `SplitView`, `Dock`
  (collapsible resizable pane stack; tab groups, regions, adopts a `Sheet`), `Stepper`,
  `Breadcrumb`, `emptyState()`.
- Core: `Component`, `h`/`__`/`icon`, `position`, `breakpoints`/`breakpointOf`/`matchBreakpoint`/`onBreakpoint` (named width bands, observed on an element or the window), `Http`/`zeyosService`, i18n, date utils, `defineElements` (declarative `<zx-*>` custom elements).
- Helpers: `formatNumber`/`formatCurrency`/`formatPercent`/`formatFileSize`/`formatRelativeTime` (locale-aware, cached `Intl`), `debounce`/`throttle`, `groupBy`/`sortBy`/`uniqueBy`, `escapeRegExp`/`highlightMatch`, `storage()` (namespaced JSON, degrades to memory), `toCsv`/`downloadBlob`/`copyToClipboard`, `truncate()`/`isTruncated()` (line clamp with the full value on hover).

## Theming
Load `zx.css` once; set `data-zx-theme` (`light`|`dark`|`auto`) and `data-zx-density` (`cozy`|`compact`) on any ancestor. Define a product theme by overriding semantic `--zx-color-*` / `--zx-control-*` tokens under `[data-zx-theme="name"]`. The theme studio controls accent, neutral tint, density, font, type size, radius, control height, and CSS-first glass material. Compact menus, pickers, tooltips, column menus, and toasts share responsive compact glass; Launcher, Modal, Dialog, and floating Sheets share a calmer reading panel. Both preserve scoped theme inheritance and refract Aurora/page content; docked Sheets and dense data surfaces remain opaque. Never use tier-1 palette tokens or raw color literals in application CSS.

## Talking to ZeyOS
Use the dedicated ZeyOS client library **`@zeyos/client`** (`npm install @zeyos/client`) for ZeyOS business data: `createZeyosClient({ platform, auth })`, typed `client.api.list/get/create/update<Resource>` over the full OpenAPI surface, and `normalizeListResult`. Zx accepts the client by injection and does not bundle it. See the `website/layouts/zeyos-invoices.layout.js` layout for a Zx-components-on-@zeyos/client reference. Zx also ships a minimal `Http`/`zeyosService` for ad-hoc in-app `remotecall`, but `@zeyos/client` is the recommended default.

The optional `./zeyos` entry maps schemas into all three record views. `SavedViewRegistry` adds
private named configurations scoped by authenticated user, workspace/fork (including null for the
base workspace), and resource through an injected atomic transport. The compatibility transport
reuses ZeyOS `userfields`; records, selection, pages, callbacks, and DOM are never persisted.

## Installing
`npm install @zeyos/zx`. Entry points: `.` (components), `./zeyos` (ZeyOS binding), `./zx.css`
(styles), and `./global` (classic script tag). Docs: https://zx.zeyos.com

## Commands
`npm run serve` (no-build documentation at http://127.0.0.1:8321/website/docs.html) · `npm test` (unit + token lint) · `npm run build` (dist bundles).
